text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A serious showdown concluded. Mejiro Ryan 
and Ines Fujin, having delivered a 
thrilling race, received generous applause 
from the venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having regained her fighting spirit from 
this fierce battle, Mejiro Ryan overflowed 
with even greater determination for the 
upcoming Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, having watched Mejiro Ryan's 
race, Mejiro McQueen reflected on the 
upcoming battle against her increasingly 
formidable rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic season is only halfway 
through. An even fiercer battle awaits 
Mejiro Ryan in the autumn.
